Subject: OptiSphere technical deep-dive — scheduling & attendee checklist

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Really appreciate the clarity on your latency and data residency constraints — that helps us shape the most relevant portion of the technical deep-dive.

Next step proposal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/infra team and your ML/ops leads. That session is intended to cover architecture fit, deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC), a short demo of runtime behavior under your estimated load, and a Q&A on security/KMS/VPN requirements.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, May 24 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed, May 25 — 14:00–15:30

Please confirm which of the two windows works and who from your side will attend (ML infra owner, platform engineering, security/procurement as needed). Our recommended attendee list from Redwood: Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer — will lead the technical walkthrough) and Ben Carter (Account Exec — commercial/next-steps).

Two quick asks to help us prepare:
1) Can you share the names/emails of the ML infra owner and any network/security point of contact?
2) Do you want us to include private deployment details (VPN/KMS/HSM) in the primary agenda or keep those to a focused breakout if required?

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary from today), sample-tdx-agenda.docx

If either of the proposed times is inconvenient we can open additional windows next week — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Avery Johnson
